title: Fourth contract amendment with SoundThinking (ShotSpotter) for gunshot detection

parts.synopsis: An ordinance to authorize the City Manager to enter into a fourth contract amendment with Soundthinking, Inc. (formerly ShotSpotter, Inc.), for the renewal of the wide-area gunshot detection service and addition of case builder software for the Little Rock Police Department.
parts.fiscal_impact: The amount of this amendment is not to exceed $188,000.00. This will be paid from 105201-61350. The original service contract was previously approved with Resolution 15,392 and amended with Resolutions 15,844 and 16,202.
parts.background: In addition to real-time gunfire detection, integrating CaseBuilder as an intelligence-gathering database enhances the department’s ability to manage and analyze critical data from criminal investigations. CaseBuilder centralizes evidence, facilitates collaboration, and provides tools to organize and connect investigative findings, ensuring more effective follow- up during investigations.

(formerly ShotSpotter, Inc.), for the Little Rock Police Department. Submitted By: Susan Altrui Little Rock Police Acting City Manager Department SYNOPSIS An ordinance to authorize the City Manager to enter into a fourth contract amendment with Soundthinking, Inc. (formerly ShotSpotter, Inc.), for the renewal of the wide-area gunshot detection service and addition of case builder software for the Little Rock Police Department. FISCAL IMPACT The amount of this amendment is not to exceed $188,000.00. This will be paid from 105201-61350. The original service contract was previously approved with Resolution 15,392 and amended with Resolutions 15,844 and 16,202. RECOMMENDATION Approval of the ordinance. BACKGROUND In addition to real-time gunfire detection, integrating CaseBuilder as an intelligence-gathering database enhances the department’s ability to manage and analyze critical data from criminal investigations. CaseBuilder centralizes evidence, facilitates collaboration, and provides tools to organize and connect investigative findings, ensuring more effective follow- up during investigations.

title: Amend Resolution 16,489 to add $77,500 for Real Time Crime Center camera subscriptions

parts.synopsis: A resolution to amend Little Rock, Ark. Resolution No. 16,489 (November 4, 2024), to authorize the City Manager to enter into a contract with Insight Public Sector, Inc., for a one (1)-year subscription renewal for the Little Rock Police Department Real Time Crime Center.
parts.fiscal_impact: The total cost for this renewal is $77,500.00. This will be paid from Account No. 105225-63360.
parts.background: Flock Safety has notified the department of a group of cameras that need a contract subscription renewal. Flock Safety is the city’s provider for license plate readers (LPRs) and is an essential tool for the apprehension of criminals and the prevention of crime. Resolution 16,489 included the renewal cost of $284,500. The amended amount is $362,000, including the cost of $77,500 to cover the license plate recognition camera with the vehicle fingerprint software.

parts.fiscal_impact: The annual renewal cost is $345,00.00 and will be paid from the department’s software account 105201-61350. Vendor selection was made through the OMINA Partners #23-6692- 03.
parts.background: Since 2020, Flock has been our provider for license plate readers. With this purchase, the department will continue to have the necessary intelligence, preventive, and investigative tools to apprehend criminals, assist with the prevention of locate and locate missing persons. Flock Safety has notified the department of a group of cameras that need a contract subscription renewal. Flock Safety is the city’s provider for license plate readers (LPRs) and is an essential tool for the apprehension of criminals and the prevention of crime. Nothing additional is added, current services will remain.
